details: Iran's Islamic Revolution Guard Corps (IRGC) has reportedly targeted at least seven oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz over the past five days, with incidents as recent as October 3rd and 4th, 2026. This escalation in naval activity, including projectile strikes and fires on vessels, is intensifying geopolitical tensions and raising concerns about global oil supply disruptions. The U.S. has been conducting military operations against Iranian targets in the region.
title: Iran's IRGC Continues Targeting Oil Tankers in Strait of Hormuz

details: The yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note reached 5.34% on October 3rd, 2026, marking its highest level since 2002. This surge is driven by ongoing geopolitical tensions, federal deficits, and increased corporate debt related to AI investments. Higher yields translate to increased borrowing costs for businesses and households, potentially slowing economic sectors like housing and auto sales. Investors are demanding more compensation as global inflation worries resurface.
title: US Treasury Yields Hit 24-Year High Amid Inflation Fears

details: Russia has intensified its attacks on Ukraine, with recent drone strikes on Kyiv hitting schools, hospitals, and bridges on October 3rd and 4th, 2026. In response, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Kyiv plans to increase its attacks on Moscow's oil refineries as part of its winter strategy. This indicates a further escalation of the conflict.
title: Russia Intensifies Attacks on Ukraine, Kyiv Targets Oil Refineries
